title: GEMgluPerspective
description: set up a perspective projection matrix

messages.description: field of view angle in the y direction, in degrees
aspect ratio (width/height) of the field of view
distance to the near clipping plane (positive)
distance to the far clipping plane (positive)

arguments.description: field of view angle in the y direction, in degrees
aspect ratio (width/height) of the field of view
distance to the near clipping plane (positive)
distance to the far clipping plane (positive)

body: [GEMgluPerspective] calls gluPerspective() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See gluPerspective in the OpenGL reference.
